name: BayGuard — Telegram booking + waitlist (configure before use)

nodes.name: Telegram — messages and buttons
nodes.notes: Receives authenticated Telegram messages and callback_query updates. Native chat/user restrictions limit this private prototype to its owner.

nodes.name: Manual — storage smoke test
nodes.notes: Starts a synthetic persistence-only check. It is not a replacement for a real Telegram end-to-end test.

nodes.name: Every minute — expire offers
nodes.notes: Scheduled sweep for due holds and newly eligible cancelled windows. Temporarily enabled only for approved private expiry QA; otherwise disabled in this handoff.

nodes.name: Telegram identity
nodes.notes: Maps sender ID, private chat ID, command, callback ID and Telegram update ID. Identity never comes from user message text.

nodes.name: Synthetic event — NO messages
nodes.notes: Builds a synthetic sender and unique probe event. This branch is restored to storage-only mode after transport QA.

nodes.name: Trusted expiry event
nodes.notes: Builds a server-owned timer event. End users cannot grant themselves the internal scheduler role through Telegram text.

nodes.name: Private test settings
nodes.notes: Defines the owner allowlist, delivery switch, server timestamp and offer lifetime. One-minute TTL is used only for explicitly approved accelerated QA; the normal setting is ten minutes.

nodes.name: Private tester only
nodes.notes: Rejects non-owner or non-private requests before reading or changing appointment state. Trusted manual storage tests use a separate synthetic branch.

nodes.name: Read appointment state
nodes.notes: Reads exactly one scoped prototype row from the native n8n Data table. Missing or duplicate state rows fail closed.

nodes.name: Button needs acknowledgement
nodes.notes: Detects real inline callbacks requiring an answerQuery acknowledgement. Ordinary text and synthetic events skip it.

nodes.name: Telegram — acknowledge button
nodes.notes: Answers the inline callback to dismiss Telegram loading feedback. An acknowledgement failure is not a booking decision.

nodes.name: Availability + booking rules
nodes.notes: Pure deterministic service/bay capacity checks, appointment ownership, explicit waitlist consent, FIFO-compatible matching, holds, expiry, deduplication and paginated Telegram menus. No LLM and no network calls.

nodes.name: Commit only if revision unchanged
nodes.notes: Writes the next state only when both row ID and expected revision still match. This is a conditional state update, not an unconditional overwrite.

nodes.name: Our commit succeeded
nodes.notes: Verifies the returned revision and execution-specific commit token before any success message can be sent. Production concurrency stress testing remains a separate gate.

nodes.name: Verified delivery context
nodes.notes: Restores the prepared messages and trusted routing context only after the state commit was verified.

nodes.name: Messages to send
nodes.notes: Routes nonempty message batches to delivery. Silent expiry or synthetic storage checks finish without Telegram calls.

nodes.name: One recipient per message
nodes.notes: Splits prepared replies and targeted offers into individual recipient items. This is not a subscriber broadcast.

nodes.name: Live delivery and tester allowlist
nodes.notes: A second delivery gate checks the live switch, recipient allowlist and non-synthetic source before Telegram sendMessage.

nodes.name: Telegram — reply with inline buttons
nodes.notes: Uses the native Telegram credential to send a message with four native inline buttons. Each label and callback has its own expression; variable menus use short pages.

nodes.name: Preview only — nothing sent
nodes.notes: Produces a readable preview when live delivery is disabled or the recipient is not allowlisted. Does not send messages.

nodes.name: Storage smoke test PASSED
nodes.notes: Reports a verified state roundtrip and zero messages sent for the manual synthetic storage branch.

nodes.name: No confirmation after storage conflict

parameters.errorMessage: State changed during this request. Nothing was confirmed or sent. Reload state before retrying.

nodes.notes: Stops on a failed/ambiguous conditional commit. No false booking confirmation is emitted; reloading and a controlled retry are required.

nodes.name: Ignore non-test users
nodes.notes: Ends non-authorized/private-chat requests without a reply or state change.

parameters.content:
## 01 / INTAKE & IDENTITY
Telegram messages + inline buttons.
Owner-only private test; configure your tester ID.
Delivery OFF by default. Separate manual check and timer.

## 02 / RESERVE BEFORE CONFIRMING
Service duration · bay capability · consent · exclusive holds.
Read state → deterministic rules → conditional commit → verify.
Normal offer lifetime: 10 minutes. Expiry scheduler OFF.

## 03 / TARGETED RECOVERY, NOT A BROADCAST
One opening → one eligible customer → one private offer.
Quote value ≠ collected revenue. No payment integration.
Independent engineering prototype; hardening required.
